question: Who among the following co-founded the Calcutta Unitarian Society and founded the Brahma Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Brahmo Sabha** served as the forerunner of the** Brahmo Samaj,** a **social-religious reform movement** in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It was founded in **1828 **with help from Indian reformer **Ram Mohan Roy.**
 
• **Akbar II, the Mughal empero**r, bestowed the title** "Raja"** upon him.
 
• Ram Mohan Roy was well-known for his efforts to **end child marriage and the sati customs.**
 
• Many historians regard Roy as the **"Father of the Bengal Renaissance."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iswar Chandra Vidyasagar:**

 
 
• In the nineteenth century, Iswar Chandra Vidyasagar was a **social reformer and educator** from India.
 
• His efforts to** simplify and modernise Bengali prose** were significant. 
 
• He is regarded as the **"Father of Bengali Prose." **
 
 
 
• **Debendranath Tagore:**
 
 
• **Indian Hindu philosopher and religious reformer** Debendranath Tagore was prominent in the **Brahmo Samaj.**
 
• In **1848,** he established the Brahmo religion, which is now known as** Brahmoism.**
 
 
 
• **Keshab Chandra Sen:**
 
 
• **Hindu philosopher and social reformer** Keshab Chandra Sen made an effort to **integrate Christian theology** within the Hindu philosophical tradition.
 
• He was a Hindu who was born in **British India's Bengal Presidency** and joined the Brahmo Samaj in 1857 before starting his own breakaway group, the** "Bharatvarshiya Brahmo Samaj," in 1866.**
